idea-plugin.name: SPF & DMARC Record Lint
idea-plugin.description:
19 offline checks on the SPF, DMARC and DKIM records in your branch — including the DMARC rewrite of May 2026

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → SPF & DMARC Record Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 19 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/spf-dmarc-record-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/spf-dmarc-record-lint

action.text: SPF & DMARC Record Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run SPF & DMARC Record Lint on the file in the editor
